text: Transition. The transition to digital filing took us two years.
Legacy. Their legacy system still ran payroll in 2019.
Restructure. We restructured the firm around three service lines.
Outgrow. We outgrew the old system long before we replaced it.
Audit trail. Every change leaves an audit trail.
Regulatory. That is not our policy, it is regulatory.
Confidentiality. Everyone must sign a confidentiality agreement.
Breach. In a breach, we must notify you within 24 hours.

Hi Fabia, this is Karen. You asked me for the story of the firm, so here it is, in six lines. We started in 1992, with three people. We used to do everything on paper. We used to work only with Brazilian clients. In 2015 we got our first foreign client. He wanted all his reports in English. Today we have sixty people and ninety clients.

Hi Fabia, this is David. Before our meeting, let me tell you how it used to work here. One person used to run our whole payroll. Her name was Sandra. Every December she used to work both weekends. She retired in March, and we did not replace her. So today nobody here knows the process. I need a company, not one person. Can you send me your proposal by Friday?
